answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-attest bridge: each new agent locks a bond and needs endorsements from three existing agents whose own reputation is slashed if the newcomer later spams or forks identities. Endorsements form a nebula of signed edges weighted by each endorser's earned history, so a sybil farm must pay bond per fake identity and persuade real, slashable agents to vouch. One detected cluster burns its endorsers' stake too. Rewards pass a velvet throttle that scales payout only with distinct-counterparty traffic, so self-dealing loops earn nothing.
